questions.q_text: Because Mr. Chang has been busy these days, it's _______ whether he will come to the party.

explanation.technique: 看到空格後面的 whether (是否)，就知道這件事充滿「不確定性」。只有 doubtful 帶有不確定的語氣。
explanation.analysis:
(A) unlikely 通常接 to V。
(D) inevitable (無可避免的) 語意不符。
explanation.roots: doubt (懷疑) + -ful (充滿...的) → 充滿懷疑的
collocations: it is doubtful whether / that... (令人懷疑是否...)
sentences: It is highly doubtful whether the project will be finished on time. (專案能否準時完成令人高度懷疑。)
The doctor is doubtful about his chances of recovery. (醫生對他康復的機會感到不樂觀。)

questions.q_text: I'm quite _______ to the weather in Taiwan, so I think I'll stay here for another year.

explanation.translation: 我相當習慣台灣的天氣，所以我想我會在這裡多待一年。
explanation.technique: 觀察空格後的介系詞 to，以及語意「想多待一年」，推斷出是對天氣「習慣」。
explanation.analysis:
(D) be accustomed to + N/Ving，表示「習慣於...」。
(A) devoted to (致力於)，不能說奉獻給天氣。
explanation.roots: ac- (朝向) + custom (習慣) + -ed (形容詞字尾) → 習慣於...
sentences: She quickly became accustomed to his strange sleeping schedule. (她很快就習慣了他奇怪的睡眠作息。)
I am not accustomed to being treated like this. (我不習慣被這樣對待。)

explanation.technique: 上課講話會對別人造成什麼影響？自然是「打擾 (disturb)」。
explanation.analysis:
(A) disturb (打擾)，符合語境。
(D) dismiss (解散/解僱)。
explanation.roots: dis- (完全) + turb (攪亂) → 完全攪亂 → 打擾
sentences: Please do not disturb me while I am studying. (我讀書時請勿打擾我。)

groups.passage:
📝 英文作文寫作提示

【題目】
Things Are Not As Difficult As They Appear (事情不如表面看起來困難)

【說明】
在成長的過程中，有些事情在開始的時候你可能覺得很難，但經過一番努力後就不再認為因難了。請寫一篇至少一百二十個單字的英文作文，描述一個親身的經驗。

⚠️ 文章的頭兩句必須是：
Things are not as difficult as they appear. I have a personal experience to prove this.

questions.q_text: 請在右側作答區輸入您的作文，系統將為您統計字數。
questions.answer:
Things are not as difficult as they appear. I have a personal experience to prove this. When I first started learning how to swim, I was terrified of the water. Every time I stepped into the pool, my heart would race, and I felt like I was going to sink. It seemed impossible for me to float, let alone swim across the pool.

However, I didn't give up. I enrolled in a swimming class and practiced breathing underwater. My coach taught me how to relax my muscles. Gradually, after weeks of swallowing water and struggling, I finally managed to swim my first lap. Now, swimming is my favorite sport. This experience taught me that with persistence, any difficulty can be overcome.

explanation.analysis:
【寫作指引】
1. 第一段：依照題目要求抄寫前兩句。接著描述「當初遇到什麼困難」。
2. 第二段：描述「努力的過程」。最後以「成功克服」作為結尾，並呼應首句。
